acceptanceCriteria: A rerun under comparable load retains the failing uninstall case reports and names the cause.
The fix or an evidenced disposition (harness bound vs product defect) is recorded, with a focused test or retained run ids.
body: Seen in RC3 lane E (V1-0397 non-reproduction, PR beamfall/corvint#741, 2026-10-10): 200 HLQ claude-code runs with corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 0, N-1 rc.2 build 360, adapter 0.3.1, Claude Code 2.1.293, darwin/arm64 M2 Max, load1 52-259 (median 122) from 8 yes burners plus 2 loops. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-10-v1-0397-upgrade-sessionstart-nonrepro.md and docs/build-log/evidence/v1-0397/runs.tsv on that branch. The uninstall case failed in 7 of 200 runs. The failure text was not retained because the runner deletes reports (see the companion ticket on retaining failed-case reports). Suspected load-sensitive timing; cause UNKNOWN. Not yet confirmed as a product defect versus harness timing.
title: HLQ claude-code uninstall case fails intermittently under heavy host load
